summary: The Taxpayers Protection Alliance (TPA) opposes sunset provisions for E-Rate programs, arguing that they create uncertainty and unnecessary expenditures. The TPA emphasizes the need for fiscal reform and modernization of the program, including eliminating unnecessary expenditures and providing more visibility into how E-Rate dollars are spent. The TPA highlights the opportunity for reform by determining whether the program's financial footprint can be reduced and establishing benchmarks for pric The FCC should consider requiring applicants receiving only one responsive bid above an appropriate dollar threshold to document additional efforts to obtain competition or explain why meaningful competition was unavailable. The claim is that the FCC should aggressively recover funds for E-Rate and impose consequences for fraud or violations.
